JSON to YAML Converter

Turn JSON into clean, readable YAML with proper nesting, list syntax, and quoting only where needed.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste valid JSON into the input box.
  2. Pick 2 or 4 space indentation.
  3. Click Convert to YAML, then copy or download the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What JSON structures are supported?

Objects, nested objects, arrays, arrays of objects, strings, numbers, booleans, and null — with 2 or 4 space indentation.

When are strings quoted?

Strings that look like numbers/booleans, contain special characters, or have leading/trailing spaces are double-quoted automatically.

Does it validate the JSON?

Yes — it validates the JSON first and shows the exact parse error with its position.

Is my data sent anywhere?

No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
